WAPDA-OPS-2026-77.content: Instructions to Bidders - Operation and maintenance support services for 220kV switchyard and associated equipment at Mangla hydel complex (Ref: WAPDA-OPS-2026-77). Scope: Three year O&M support services contract for 220kV switchyard covering preventive maintenance, testing of switchgear and transformer oil, and annual shutdown support at Mangla hydel complex. Tender fee: PKR 10,000. Bid security: Bid security of PKR 3,500,000 as bank guarantee from a scheduled bank. Last date of submission of bids: 04-Nov-2026 at 1200 hours. Bids will be opened on 05-Nov-2026 at 1400 hours. Eligibility: The bidder shall hold a valid PEC licence in category C-A. The bidder must have completed at least 2 similar O&M contracts within the last 7 years. The bidder must have an average annual turnover of PKR 800,000,000. An affidavit of non-blacklisting on a stamp paper of PKR 100 shall be furnished along with the bid, together with a duly filled Form of Tender, a power of attorney and a list of key personnel with their CVs. Prices shall be firm and fixed without price adjustment for the full contract period. Liquidated damages of 0.02 percent per day shall apply for delay in mobilisation. Retention money of 5 percent shall be deducted from monthly invoices. Performance security of 3 percent of the annual contract value shall be furnished on award. The Employer may terminate the contract for convenience on 60 days written notice. The Contractor's liability under this Contract shall be without limitation. The Contractor shall furnish an advance payment guarantee if an advance of 15 percent of the annual contract value is released on commencement. All disputes shall be referred to arbitration in accordance with the Rules of Arbitration of the International Chamber of Commerce and the seat of arbitration shall be Singapore. The Employer may suspend the Works at its convenience. No extension of time shall be allowed except where the cause is force majeure, and the Contractor shall give written notice within 7 days of the event. Insurance for the works shall be arranged by the Contractor and the Contractor shall indemnify the Employer against third party claims.

Schedule of Requirements - WAPDA O&M support services. Item 1: Affidavit of non-blacklisting on stamp paper of PKR 100, mandatory. Item 2: Valid PEC licence in category C-A, original with copy, mandatory. Item 3: Average annual turnover of PKR 800,000,000, last 5 audited years, mandatory. Item 4: Minimum 2 similar O&M contracts, within 7 years, mandatory. Item 5: ISO 45001 certification, valid copy, mandatory. Item 6: List of plant and equipment with ownership, Form A-9, mandatory. Item 7: Key personnel CVs with PEC registration, not less than 6 staff, mandatory. Item 8: Audited financial statements, last 3 years, mandatory. Item 9: Performance guarantee of 3 percent, on award, mandatory. Item 10: Insurance policy for third party liability, minimum PKR 10,000,000, mandatory.
